pages.title: About
pages.content:
## ORD for the Sciences

Two days at the **BC Building, EPFL, Lausanne**, 24–25 October 2024, co-organized by the **Swiss Data Science Center** and **EPFL Open Science**.

The event explored the potential and impact of Open Research Data on the sciences. Participants from academic, private and public sector organizations joined forces to unlock the power of open research datasets and infrastructures, embracing open principles and fostering innovation.

**20 teams worked on 15 projects** across two tracks, with a maximum of 100 participants.

pages.title: Tracks
pages.content:
## Research Data Infrastructures (RDI)

Prototyping new research-data-infrastructure initiatives.

## Data Science

Developing tools, models and knowledge on top of open research data.

Teams could optimize datasets, build analytical models, and share code and best practices across both tracks.

pages.title: Programme
pages.content:
## Day 1 — Thursday 24 October 2024

Check-in, keynotes on the importance of open data, then group work sessions. Food and beverages provided.

## Day 2 — Friday 25 October 2024

Continued development, project submissions, presentations, voting and the awards ceremony. Food and beverages provided.

pages.title: Working environment
pages.content: Teams worked on **Renku**, SDSC's open-source knowledge infrastructure for collaborative and reproducible data science — providing shared project environments and GPU access for the duration of the hackathon.
